svg.aria-label: Above left, one parent: 12 by 12 fine clump cells in 16 patches of 3 by 3, one patch shaded. Above right, that patch's nine clumps as authored and after one positive quarter-turn, which moves the clump at (x, z) to (z, 2 - x). Below, world cells -13 to 0 along one axis with the parent and local cell that floor division gives each: cell -13 is parent -2, local 11; cells -12 to -1 are parent -1, local 0 to 11; cell 0 is parent 0, local 0.
